follow_up.reference: The question expenses every executed fee immediately. Buying shares generated that cash charge whether or not all inventory has since been sold.

follow_up.question: How could a cash-ledger check detect an omitted unrealized component?
follow_up.reference: Combine execution cash and fee outflows with the marked value of ending inventory. Omitting that inventory value would fail the total-profit reconciliation.
